summary: Report per-NIC link speed and host uptime in host inventory: the agent reads /sys/class/net/<name>/speed and /proc/uptime on each inventory probe and reports optional nics[].speed_mbps and uptime_seconds, which the Controller passes through unchanged on GET /api/v1/hosts.

guide.reason: No operator workflow changes here: the console redesign UI slice consumes the fields and updates the guide with the screens that show them.

api.reason: Additive: Inventory gains optional uptime_seconds and NIC gains optional speed_mbps on POST /api/v1/agent/report and GET /api/v1/hosts; both are omitted when unknown and by older agents. Report JSON is decoded strictly, so the shared Controller-before-Core upgrade rule applies.

roadmap.reason: Supports the console redesign already planned in docs/plans/2026-09-23-controller-console-redesign.md; no phase or gate changes.

state.reason: Observed state read fresh on every inventory probe; nothing is persisted on the host, and the Controller keeps only its existing copy of the last report.

verification.method: go test ./internal/agent -run TestNICSpeedAndUptimeParsing (1000, -1, missing speed file; 12345.67 54321.00 and missing uptime; snapshot carries both); go test ./internal/controller -run TestHostsReportNICSpeedAndUptime (fields reach GET /api/v1/hosts, unknown speed omitted); python3 -m unittest tests.test_api_contract; python3 scripts/generate_api.py --check.
